# SEO

FAMILY SYSTEM: this skill is one folder of the claude-seo plugin family; its bundled tools, launcher (scripts/claude-seo at the repository root) and sibling seo-* skills live outside this folder, so a standalone copy lacks them. The orchestrator hub of the claude-seo family: it routes /seo commands to the specialised seo-* sub-skills (separate listings) and spawns the family's sub-agents for full audits, while itself doing business-type detection, the 10-principle synthesis framework, quality gates and Health Score weighting, loading its 17 references on demand. At use its tools fetch the target site's pages and, when the user has configured them, call Google/Moz/Bing/DataForSEO APIs with the user's own keys. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and appends a 'Built by agricidaniel' community footer after major deliverables.

Part of the Claude SEO family. Installing this listing alone copies only this skill's folder, without the shared launcher, the shared scripts or the sibling skills. For the full family install, its prerequisites and its Muse limits, see the guide: How to Install the Claude SEO Family - /guides/how-to-install-the-claude-seo-family/ - and the other core listings: seo, seo-agentic, seo-audit, seo-backlinks, seo-cluster, seo-competitor-pages, seo-content, seo-content-brief, seo-drift, seo-ecommerce, seo-flow, seo-geo, seo-google, seo-hreflang, seo-image-gen, seo-images, seo-local, seo-maps, seo-page, seo-plan...
